workouts.title: Week Overview
workouts.description:
This is the final week of our Base Strength & Endurance Phase. This week will be a test week, but will simultaneously serve as a preparation week for our next training phase: the weightlifting cycle which starts next week. So outside of the testing pieces, you should feel very good, don’t push anything too hard here.
This Test week should help to stimulate the CNS for the weightlifting test next week. Bring on all the 1RM’s! 

Have fun, good luck! Wishing you many PR’s!

B. Mobility
B1. Soft tissue mobilization
With a barbell, a foam roller or a LaCrosse ball
45-60 seconds/side

5/5

C. Specific
3 sets
3 box jumps @ high 
5/5 Bulgarian deadlifts
(https://youtu.be/GfhXrCB7AvQ)
-Then-
build up your deadlift with only concentric reps (Drop the bar from the top)
5-3-1 @ascending
*We do the concentric to prevent eccentric fatigue and allow your body to prepare for the fast twitch nature of the single concentric pull off the floor.
